tools.description: Flash-Friendly File System formatter optimized for NAND flash memory
tools.usage: make_f2fs /dev/sdX # Format device with F2FS\nmake_f2fs -l volume_label /dev/sdX # Set volume label\nmake_f2fs -f /dev/sdX # Force format

tools.description: F2FS formatter with case-folding support for case-insensitive filesystems
tools.usage: make_f2fs_casefold -O casefold /dev/sdX # Enable case folding\nmake_f2fs_casefold -c /dev/sdX # Check device before format

tools.description: Ext2/3/4 filesystem creator with advanced formatting options
tools.usage: mke2fs -t ext4 /dev/sdX # Create ext4 filesystem\nmke2fs -j /dev/sdX # Create ext3 with journal\nmke2fs -T largefile /dev/sdX # Optimize for large files
